# Green Jeep Tours

> > Guided jeep tours and wildlife safaris in Rocky Mountain National Park, Estes Park, and surrounding Colorado wilderness areas.

Green Jeep Tours offers year-round guided adventures including winter safaris, elk rut viewing, waterfall hikes, and off-road 4x4 wilderness excursions. Tours explore iconic locations like Bear Lake Corridor, Trail Ridge Road, and Old Fall River Road with experienced guides like Shaggy.

## Key Topics

- Rocky Mountain National Park (RMNP)
- Estes Park
- Bear Lake Corridor
- Trail Ridge Road
- Wildlife viewing
- Winter safari tours
- Elk rut viewing
- High-altitude touring
- Off-road 4x4 adventures
- Waterfall hiking
- Guided jeep tours
- Allenspark wilderness
- Grand Lake
- Old Fall River Road
- Colorado national park tours

## Rocky Mountain National Park Tours

- [The Best of Rocky](https://www.greenjeeptour.com/bestofrocky): Extended Rocky Mountain National Park safari with wildlife and hiking
- [Bear Lake Corridor Tour](https://www.greenjeeptour.com/bearlake): Guided jeep tour of Bear Lake and Sprague Lake in RMNP
- [Waterfall Hiking Tour](https://www.greenjeeptour.com/waterfallhiking): Family-friendly waterfall hiking tour in Rocky Mountain National Park
- [Rocky Mountain Winter Safari](https://www.greenjeeptour.com/wintersafari): Winter safari tour through Rocky Mountain National Park and Estes Park

## Specialty Wildlife & Adventure Tours

- [Ruttin' Around Elk Viewing](https://www.greenjeeptour.com/elkrut): Fall elk rut viewing tour at sunrise/sunset in Rocky Mountain NP
- [Off-Road 4x4 Wilderness Tour](https://www.greenjeeptour.com/4x4tour): Off-road 4x4 adventure through Allenspark and national forest areas
- [Private Tour](https://www.greenjeeptour.com/privatetour): Custom private jeep tours of Rocky Mountain National Park and area

## Tour Guides & Gallery

- [Shaggy - Tour Guide](https://www.greenjeeptour.com/shaggy): Tour guide Shaggy profile and bio for RMNP and Estes Park tours
- [Gallery](https://www.greenjeeptour.com/gallery): Photo gallery of RMNP jeep tours, wildlife, and seasonal adventures

## Visitor Information & Support

- [Altitude Sickness Guide](https://www.greenjeeptour.com/altitude-sickness): Health and safety guide for high-altitude touring in Rocky Mountains
- [Contact Us](https://www.greenjeeptour.com/new-page): Contact and booking information for Estes Park jeep tours
